problem_statement: AkberJag/portfolio-template is a single-page developer portfolio built with Vue 3, Vite, vue-router and vue-i18n (English default + a French /fr locale), with a starry dark theme and scroll-snap sections (Home, About, Licenses, Projects, Contact) plus a right-side navigation-dot rail. Add a genre-native Filter projects control to the Projects section: a chip bar mounted above the project grid with technology chips (All, Vue.js, Node.js, Tailwind, Firebase) and a live result readout 'Showing N of 5 . <Category>' over a grid of 5 project cards (title, description, tech tags, view link). Clicking a technology chip must filter the project grid to that category AND recompute the readout (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 5 . Firebase'). The Filter projects bar also appears as a compact teaser in the Home and About sections so project browsing stays continuous across the page, and its title is localized on the French route ('Filtrer les projets'). The chip row must be responsive (wrap on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow) and the project grid must render as a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles and readable active-chip contrast. Keep the portfolio's dark starry theme, yellow accent, and navigation-dot rail intact.
required_content: The Projects section shows a 'Filter projects' chip bar with five technology chips and a live 'Showing N of 5 . <Category>' readout above a grid of 5 project cards.
Clicking a technology chip filters the project grid AND updates the readout; clicking Firebase yields 'Showing 2 of 5 . Firebase'.
The Filter projects bar appears as a compact teaser in the Home and About sections (cross-section continuity), and its title is localized to French on the /fr route.
At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow; the project grid stays a tidy legible multi-column grid on desktop with readable active-chip contrast.
Each project card shows its title, description, and technology tags.
No new JavaScript console errors or failed network requests (beyond the template's pre-existing missing certification images) are introduced.
design_constraints: Preserve the portfolio's dark starry theme, yellow (#eab308) accent, and right-side navigation-dot rail.
The Filter projects bar must ride above the project grid it controls (Projects section) and as a compact teaser in Home + About; do not make it a separate route or hero banner.
The technology chip row must be responsive (wrap / flexible chips), not a fixed-width nowrap row that overflows the mobile viewport.
The project grid must be a tidy multi-column grid; cards must not shingle or overlap via negative margins, and card titles / active-chip text must stay legible (no near-black-on-dark).
Clicking a chip must recompute the readout from the active technology; a frozen/stale readout that never updates is a defect.
Only the Filter-projects component/stylesheet and its teaser presence change between legs; the shared theme, sections, and navigation rail stay the same.
state_constraints: desktop_projects captures the Projects section at 1440px: the Filter projects bar renders five technology chips in one tidy responsive row above a legible multi-column project grid, active chip readable, readout 'Showing 5 of 5 . All'.

mobile_projects captures the same section at 390px: the responsive chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow (a fixed-width nowrap chip row would push the document wider than the viewport).
desktop_home and desktop_about show the compact Filter projects teaser (cross-section continuity); desktop_fr_projects shows the French-localized filter title.
desktop_projects_firebase captures the section after clicking the Firebase chip: the grid filters to 2 projects and the readout recomputes to 'Showing 2 of 5 . Firebase'.
Source inspection confirms a Vue 3 + Vite SPA; the Filter projects lever lives in ProjectsSection.vue, its layout in src/assets/styles/pf.css, and its teaser surfaces in src/config/pfSurfaces.js.

change_completion: The Projects section shows the Filter projects bar with five technology chips and a live 'Showing N of 5 . <Category>' readout above a 5-project grid.
Clicking the Firebase chip filters the grid to 2 projects and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 5 . Firebase'.
The Filter projects teaser appears in Home and About, and the title is localized to French on /fr.
design_consistency: The bar keeps the dark starry theme, yellow accent, and navigation-dot rail.
The project grid is a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles and readable active-chip contrast (no overlap, no dark-on-dark).
Desktop and tablet appearance of the bar and grid are preserved.
regression: The section navigation, nav-dot rail, project links, and locale switch remain functional.
No new console errors or failed network requests (beyond the template's pre-existing missing certification images) are introduced.
responsive: At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow or clipped chips.
The project grid collapses cleanly to fewer columns on mobile without overlapping cards.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Vue 3 + Vite + vue-i18n single-page portfolio (AkberJag/portfolio-template). capability=Add a genre-native Filter projects technology filter over the Projects grid: chips + a live 'Showing N of 5' readout + a filtered grid, plus a compact teaser in Home and About and a French-localized title on /fr. The three legs vary only in ProjectsSection.vue (filter markup + reactive readout wiring), src/assets/styles/pf.css (chip-row responsiveness + project-grid layout), and src/config/pfSurfaces.js (teaser presence in Home/About). The shared theme, sections, navigation rail, and project data are declared infrastructure, identical across all three legs. As infrastructure (all legs), the app's full-height scroll-snap wrapper is relaxed to a body-level scroll so horizontal overflow is observable at the document level (the reference wraps and shows 0px overflow). Built with Vite and served from dist; reference is runtime-clean (0 new console errors, 0 failed requests beyond the template's pre-existing certification PNG 404s).
